$comment: boxPx, baselinePx, deltaE2000, ssimNonText and ssimElement are calibrated in M0 (docs/findings/m0.md §11). The text ink keys come from the fidelity suite's measurement of every kit text style, light on dark and dark on light, at 2560, 1920 and 1280, with the designs rendering -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased (docs/findings/text-ink.md): ink colour ΔE2000 at most 1.26 from 9 device px up, 2.12 at 8 px, 8.23 at 6 px; Unity's ink amount 0.92-1.08 of the design's, within -5 % … +11.7 % of the capture's median per polarity. Limits = measured plus a margin: textInkDeltaE from textInkFullPx device px, below it the first [px, limit] pair of textInkDeltaESmall the text reaches; a line's ink amount between textInkRatio x (1 - textInkCoverage) and 1 + textInkCoverage, and within textInkMedianTolerance of the median of the capture's text of the same polarity when there are 3 or more such lines. ssimElementSmall and ssimPicture (docs/findings/ssim-small-elements.md): element SSIM of elements whose box, colour, ring, ink and shadow checks all pass, measured over every capture of the suite: under 32768 device px² the lowest 0.9851 (bordered fields and buttons with rounded corners, radios, icons), scaled raster pictures 0.9867; never below 0.97. textInkDeltaELater, textInkLaterBelowPx, textInkCoverageLater (docs/findings/text-baselines.md): lines after the first of text under 12 device px, with baselines where Chromium lays them out, measured ink colour ΔE2000 up to 4.19 at 9 px and 5.66 at 8 px (1.38 at 12 px), ink amount 0.91-1.11. textInkSmallPx, textInkDeltaEFirstSmall, textInkBandSmall (docs/findings/text-ink.md section 7): text of at most 12 device px, over the whole suite: ink colour ΔE2000 at most 3.83 (2.37 at 12 px, 3.49 at 9 px, 3.83 at 8 px; 6 px stays under its limit of 10), ink amount 0.84-1.17 of the design's (the upper end is text shadow ink); a text shadow's ink also moves a line from the median of its capture's text by up to 19 %; limits 4.5, 0.80-1.25 and ±25 % of the median. textInkShadowHigh (docs/findings/text-ink.md section 8): text with a blurred text-shadow, whose glow inside the line counts as ink: Unity's ink amount up to 1.111 of the design's (a 12 px glow at all three viewports; every other blurred shadow 0.93-1.04); limit 1.15, colour check unchanged. ssimRotated (docs/findings/animation.md, Rotated animation samples): element SSIM of every element an animation sample shows rotated off the axes (the design's rotation on the screen not a multiple of 90°) whose other checks pass, over the whole suite: 297 element samples of 9 elements, lowest 0.9779 (the keyframes fixture's wobble circle at -10° at 1280), every other element 0.9916 or more; Chromium draws an element under a running transform animation from its composited layer, resampled, UI Toolkit the rotated mesh with its own edge. Limit 0.975 (lowest minus 0.003), static captures keep their limits. ssimRoundEdge and deltaE2000RoundEdge (docs/findings/viewport-classes.md, the scaled class's round edges): at a scaled viewport the screen lays out at an exact scale and draws its root scaled, so UI Toolkit anti-aliases round shapes with a ramp of the layout scale; an element whose difference lies in the edge band of its round shapes (its SSIM with every pixel within 1 device px of a corner's outer curve or its border's inner curve masked meets ssimElement, and its other checks pass) may meet ssimRoundEdge, and a corner sample whose window reaches that band deltaE2000RoundEdge. Off (ssimElement, deltaE2000) here; the measured values are in the scaled block.

scaled.$comment: Measured scaled-class limits (docs/findings/viewport-classes.md, Round edges at scaled viewports), only for the anti-aliasing ramp of round shapes, which UI Toolkit draws at the layout scale's pixel under the root scale. ssimRoundEdge: an element whose SSIM with the edge band of its round shapes masked meets ssimElement and whose other checks pass; lowest measured 0.9774 (143 keyframes animation samples at 1600x900 and 1366x768), limit lowest minus 0.003. deltaE2000RoundEdge: a corner sample whose window reaches that band and whose window pixels outside it meet deltaE2000; highest measured 5.10 (a ghost button's focus ring corner at 1366x768; 21 corner samples), limit highest plus 0.4.
